evals.prompt: 讓這三個同 viewBox 的角色 SVG 能在開心、思考、難過狀態間切換。快速連點時不能閃回舊狀態，並保留原本的眼睛和漸層。
evals.expected_output: An interruptible state transition implementation using per-part correspondence and preserved paint references.
assertions: Uses the existing project framework and identifies shared and state-specific parts without requiring React or Figma.
Selects transforms, compatible coordinate interpolation, or an explicit alternative per part; accounts for transforms and subpaths.
Cancels active frame callbacks and delayed entrances, then starts from current rendered values.
Tests intermediate frames, rapid changes, reduced motion, and teardown; does not claim static raster output proves playback.

evals.prompt: Animate the supplied static SVG loading icon in our existing plain HTML page. Keep the center aligned and honor reduced motion. No framework or package installation.
evals.expected_output: A small browser-compatible SVG/CSS change with an intentional reduced-motion still.
assertions: Uses existing HTML/CSS without introducing React, a CDN, or a morph package.
Defines transform ownership and pivot in the relevant SVG coordinate space.
Preserves the accessible loading meaning in reduced-motion mode.
Reports actual browser playback checks or explicitly unverified visual behavior.

evals.prompt: Morph these compound filled paths with holes and separate open stroke subpaths. Their command sequences differ. Please do not replace all curves with crude polygons.
evals.expected_output: An explicit per-part strategy preserving compound fill semantics and checking tool support.
assertions: Does not equate matching command letters with correct correspondence or interpolate arc flags as arbitrary floats.
Does not blindly split filled compound subpaths and lose their holes.
Evaluates the actual chosen morph library or uses re-authored correspondence/crossfade where appropriate.
Preserves original paths, declares any optional library/version, and verifies intermediate results.
